_comment: Machine-readable allowlist for .security/audit-gate.mjs (the exception-aware npm-audit gate used in api/Dockerfile + ui/Dockerfile). Each entry allows ONE GHSA to not fail the HIGH/CRITICAL gate until review_due. Human record + full justification: .security/vulnerability-register.yaml. Keep the two in sync.

allow.reason: zod <4.6.6 memory-exhaustion advisory matches the pinned v3 line (3.25.76/3.23.8); the only fix is the breaking v3-to-v4 major migration (main-owned). Time-boxed pending that migration; human record in vulnerability-register.yaml.

@ai-sdk/provider-utils <=3.0.27 uncontrolled-resource-consumption advisory on the nested dev-only copy (ollama-ai-provider 1.2.0 via engram, pinned 2.2.8, no v2 fix published); bumping the v2 line under main-owned engram risks runtime breakage. Time-boxed pending upstream/main remediation; human record in vulnerability-register.yaml.
